question: Why is the maximum use of space emphasized in a good layout?

options.A: Layout looks good in small spaces

explanation: The main goal of a good layout is to ensure maximum use of space and prevent wastage.
source: Mazida Khatun Govt. Women's College, Lalmonirhat

question: If adequate light and air cannot be arranged in the layout, what should be done?

options.C: Artificial means of light and air should be arranged

explanation: If natural arrangements are not possible, artificial means must be arranged.
source: Mazida Khatun Govt. Women's College, Lalmonirhat

question: Mr. Mumin set up a luxury car showroom in Gulshan. What is the reason for this?
explanation: While affluent customers are important, specific locational advantages like car parking facilities are critical for a luxury showroom in areas like Gulshan. (Note: This interpretation is specific to the textbook context.)
source: Govt. Akbar Ali College, Ullapara, Sirajganj

question: Machine layout is part of what?
explanation: Machine layout is a part of Production Management.
source: Govt. Haji Muhammad Mohsin College, Khulna

question: What kind of principle is followed in process layout?
explanation: In a process layout, departments are grouped based on the type of work or expertise (specialization principle).
source: Govt. Haji Muhammad Mohsin College, Khulna

question: What is the objective of a layout?

options.A: Improving external structure of the organization

explanation: The main objective of a layout or arrangement is the correct and maximum use of space.

question: An effective layout ensures what?
explanation: An effective layout ensures good supervision.

question: What is helpful in increasing the beauty or appeal of an object?
explanation: A proper layout or arrangement increases the beauty of a space or product.
source: Cantonment Public School and College, Jahanabad

question: Which layout is required for the construction of Padma Bridge?
explanation: For bridge construction, Fixed Position Layout is applicable.
source: Dr. Abdur Razzak Municipal College, Jessore

question: What type of layout is needed for a hotel or motel business?
explanation: Hotel business requires Service Layout.
source: Dr. Abdur Razzak Municipal College, Jessore

question: Good layout includes the maximum use of what type of space?
explanation: The design and maximum use of the allocated space is the task of layout.

question: The layout where work centers or departments are arranged in a line is called—
explanation: In product layout, the production flow is arranged in a straight line.

question: What is the main objective of a layout?

options.C: Increasing the beauty of the organization

explanation: The optimum use of inputs is the main objective of a layout.
source: Viqarunnisa Noon School and College, Dhaka

question: In which concept are management and workers allocated side-by-side spaces?
explanation: In modern office landscaping, people are seated side-by-side for collaboration.
source: Khilgaon Govt. High School, Khilgaon, Dhaka

question: Arranging similar products in the sequence of operations is called—
explanation: In Product Layout, machinery is arranged according to the product sequence.
source: Shaheed Bir Uttam Lt. Anwar Girls College, Dhaka

question: The layout where work centers or departments are arranged in a line is called—
explanation: This is the definition of Product Layout.

question: Machine layout is part of what?
explanation: Machine layout is an important branch of production management.
source: Mirpur Pearls Ideal Laboratory Institute, Dhaka

question: A layout is called a good layout if it— (i. Ensures proper use of space ii. Keeps distance between work centers short iii. Has flexibility) Which is correct?
explanation: All three are characteristics of a good layout.

question: Systems used in warehouse layout are— (i. A-one ii. Zone iii. Zero-one) Which is correct?
explanation: Zone and Zero-one are well-known warehouse layout systems.
source: University Laboratory School and College, Dhaka

question: Product layout is also called— (i. Production Line ii. Assembly Line iii. Product Line) Which is correct?
explanation: Product layout is known as Production Line and Assembly Line. Product Line is a different concept.
source: Samsul Haque Khan School and College

question: Suitable for shipbuilding is— (i. Fixed position layout ii. Office layout iii. Warehouse layout) Which is correct?
explanation: Fixed Position layout is suitable for shipbuilding.
source: Viqarunnisa Noon School and College, Dhaka

question: It is possible for the organization to achieve the desired goals— (i. In ideal layout ii. In good layout iii. In well-organized layout) Which is correct?
explanation: Any good or ideal layout helps achieve goals.
source: Shaheed Bir Uttam Lt. Anwar Girls College, Dhaka

question: It is possible for the organization to achieve the desired goals— (i. Through ideal layout ii. Through good layout iii. Through well-organized layout) Which is correct?
explanation: Repetitive question. Same answer.

question: In retail store layout, the factors considered are— (i. Nature of products ii. Attracting customers iii. Social status of customers) Which is correct?
explanation: Product nature and customer attraction are the main considerations. Social status is not.

question: Mr. Tanha is the managing director of Sunmun Properties, a developer company in Uttara. He is constructing a multistoried building. What type of layout will this business fall under?
explanation: In building construction, the product is stationary and workers move around, so it is a Fixed Position Layout.

question: The benefits he will get through this business are— (i. Improvement of production process ii. Cost reduction iii. Assistance in buying and selling) Which is correct?
explanation: Benefit of cost reduction and process improvement.

question: G-K does not sell the produced clothes but displays them. What type of layout does this task of G-K belong to?
explanation: Displaying and stocking fall under the Warehouse Layout.

question: By establishing a showroom, what type of layout will G-K establish?
explanation: A showroom is a retail store, so it is a Retail Layout.

question: Mr. Ibrahim is the managing director of Apex Properties, a developer company in Dhanmondi. He is constructing a multistoried building. What type of layout will this business of Mr. Ibrahim fall under?
explanation: Construction industry is an example of Fixed Position Layout.

question: The benefits he will get through this business are— (i. Improvement of production process ii. Cost reduction iii. Product transfer) Which is correct?
explanation: In Fixed Position Layout, the product is not transferred.

question: Mr. Sahid formulated his office layout plan. He gave special importance to ensuring the layout can be easily changed in the future. Which characteristic of a good layout is highlighted here?
explanation: Changeability indicates the characteristic of Flexibility.

question: By keeping the option to change the layout, what type of benefit will the organization achieve?
explanation: Flexibility helps meet future changing demands.

question: Aarong has a showroom in Chittagong. They sell their produced goods here at retail. They display shirts, panjabis, bags, nakshikantha, showpieces etc. separately. What is the layout of Aarong's showroom like?
explanation: For retail sales, the Retail Layout is used.

question: The benefits of Aarong's layout are— (i. Easy to find ii. Employment is created iii. Time is saved) Which is correct?
explanation: Displaying neatly makes finding easy and saves time. Employment is not a direct benefit of the layout.
